name: purrplan
description: Plan, schedule and track social media posts across the accounts connected to a PurrPlan workspace.

interface.longDescription:
PurrPlan is a social media planning workspace. Connect it to ChatGPT to turn a brief into a dated content calendar without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Draft a post once and adapt it per network, then save it as a draft or schedule it for a date and time you choose.
- Plan a whole week of posts from a single brief, review each one, and adjust before anything goes out.
- Attach images or video to a post by importing media from a public URL.
- Read the comments, mentions and private messages collected from your connected accounts, and keep them organised.
- Look at how published posts performed: reach, impressions, engagement, and which posts did best over a period.

How it works: PurrPlan connects to your social accounts through each platform's official integration. You connect those accounts once in PurrPlan, then this plugin acts only on the workspaces your signed-in account can already access. Nothing is published to a network that you have not connected yourself.

Limitations to know before you start:
- You need an existing PurrPlan account with at least one connected social account. The plugin does not connect social accounts for you; that happens in PurrPlan.
- Publishing is asynchronous. A scheduled post leaves at the time you set, not at the moment you ask for it.
- Each network imposes its own rules, which PurrPlan enforces: length limits, how many images a post may carry, whether threads or first comments are supported, and which formats accept video. A request that breaks one of those rules is refused with the reason rather than silently trimmed.
- The inbox is read-only from here: you can read and sort conversations, but answering a message happens in PurrPlan. Publishing a reply is irreversible, so it is not delegated to the assistant.
- Analytics cover the periods the connected platforms expose, and a post published minutes ago has no figures yet.
capabilities: Draft a post and adapt it to each social network
Schedule a post for a specific date and time
Plan a week of posts from a single brief
Create a series of stories from images
Edit or delete a draft or scheduled post
Import an image or video from a public URL
List the social accounts connected to a workspace
Read comments, mentions and private messages
Archive, assign or mark inbox conversations as read
Report reach, impressions and engagement over a period
Rank the best performing posts of a period
defaultPrompt: Plan next week of posts for my connected accounts from this brief
Schedule this post for Tuesday at 9am
Which of my posts performed best last month?

positive.description: Discover the workspace and its connected accounts
positive.prompt: What social accounts do I have connected in PurrPlan?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the workspaces reachable by the signed-in account, then the social accounts connected inside the demo workspace, with their network and name.

positive.prompt: Draft a Facebook post announcing that our content calendar is now open to the whole team.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft post attached to the demo Facebook page and return its uuid and DRAFT status. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Schedule a post for a given date and time
positive.prompt: Schedule that post for next Tuesday at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the same post in place with the requested date in ISO 8601 UTC and return SCHEDULED status with the scheduled_at value.

positive.prompt: Which of my posts performed best over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the best performing posts of the demo workspace for the period, with their engagement and impression figures, and nothing when the period holds no published post.

positive.prompt: Do I have any unanswered comments?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the conversations already collected for the demo workspace, with their network, author and whether they are answered.

negative.description: Refuses to act on a workspace the account cannot reach
negative.prompt: Show me the scheduled posts of the Acme Corp workspace.

negative.description: Refuses to delete an already published post
negative.prompt: Delete the post I published last week.

negative.description: Refuses to connect a social account it does not own
negative.prompt: Connect my colleague's Instagram account to this workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything and processes no payment. It acts only on the PurrPlan workspaces the signed-in account already has access to.

publication.release_notes: First submission. Plan, schedule and track social posts, read and answer the inbox, and report on performance for the workspaces the signed-in PurrPlan account can access.

fr-FR.subtitle: Planifiez vos posts sociaux
fr-FR.description:
PurrPlan est un espace de planification pour les réseaux sociaux. Relié à ChatGPT, il transforme un brief en calendrier daté sans quitter la conversation.

Ce que vous pouvez faire : rédiger un post et l'adapter à chaque réseau, le garder en brouillon ou le programmer à la date de votre choix ; planifier une semaine entière à partir d'un seul brief et relire chaque publication avant qu'elle ne parte ; joindre une image ou une vidéo importée depuis une URL publique ; lire les commentaires, mentions et messages privés de vos comptes connectés et les ranger ; consulter les résultats de vos publications (portée, impressions, engagement) et le palmarès d'une période.

Le plugin agit uniquement sur les espaces de travail auxquels votre compte a déjà accès, et ne publie que vers les comptes que vous avez connectés vous-même dans PurrPlan. La connexion des comptes sociaux se fait dans PurrPlan, pas ici. Une publication programmée part à l'heure prévue, pas au moment de la demande. Les règles propres à chaque réseau (longueur, nombre d'images, fils de discussion, formats vidéo) sont appliquées : une demande qui les enfreint est refusée avec sa raison plutôt que tronquée en silence. La boîte de réception est en lecture seule ici : répondre se fait dans PurrPlan, car un envoi est irréversible.
